name: Chattahoochee
gaps: Parcels are ParcelsChattCo (RVRC_ELA) (https://services1.arcgis.com/Ug5xGQbHsD8zuZzM/arcgis/rest/services/ParcelsChattCo/FeatureServer/0). Acreage is parsed from Total_acre because the field is not numeric in SQL, then kept at 5.0–150.0 inclusive. Rows that do not parse use geodesic polygon area. No Opportunity Zone status, school grade, or base flood elevation is stored.
Source query returned 1785 rows; 322 distinct parcel ids stayed in the 5.0–150.0 acre band after the geometry check.
Pass 2 enrichment is from rural-oz-pass2 csv (tax HTML-only, sale HTML-only, owner REST). GDOT AADT stays the query-time statewide join.
Pass 2 tax is HTML-only. qPublic was not requested, and no tax value was copied from an HTML report.
Pass 2 sale is HTML-only. Zero-filled SALE_VAL columns are not stored as a sale price, and qPublic was not requested.
Property-appraiser links are filled from the pass-2 template with each parcel id and were not requested. Owner phone and email are not ingested.
